sources.title: Using AI assistants with S3 Storage Lens tables
sources.snippet: Overview Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a standardized way for AI applications to access and utilize contextual information. The MCP Server for Amazon S3 Tables provides tools that enable AI assistants to interact with your S3 Tables data using natural language interfaces. This democratizes data access and enables individuals across technical skill levels to work with S3 Storage Lens metrics.
